command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime
HEAD=a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b
DEST="$ROOT/releases/${HEAD}-full-777-v1"
EXPECTED_OLD=572a07d2d6b69b1faeb747faab9b2b3f221b2e69
test -f "$DEST/OMEGA_COMPOSED_RELEASE.json"
python3 - <<'PY'
import fcntl,json,os,pathlib,sqlite3,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime'); target=root/'releases/a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b-full-777-v1'; cur=root/'current'; expected=root/'releases/572a07d2d6b69b1faeb747faab9b2b3f221b2e69'
actual=cur.resolve() if cur.exists() else None
print('CURRENT_BEFORE',actual)
if actual not in (expected,target): raise SystemExit('ABORT_UNEXPECTED_CURRENT:'+str(actual))
lockp=root/'state/omega-supervisor.lock'; lockp.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); f=open(lockp,'a+')
try:
 fcntl.flock(f.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB); print('SUPERVISOR_LOCK=FREE'); fcntl.flock(f.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_UN)
except BlockingIOError:
 print('SUPERVISOR_LOCK=HELD')
 status=root/'state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json'
 if actual==target and status.exists():
  d=json.loads(status.read_text()); pid=int(d.get('pid') or 0)
  try: os.kill(pid,0); print('ALREADY_LIVE_PID',pid); sys.exit(42)
  except OSError: pass
 raise SystemExit('ABORT_ACTIVE_SUPERVISOR')
db=root/'data/omega_unified.db'
if db.exists():
 con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro',uri=True); names={r[0] for r in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")}
 for t,col in [('relay_ledger','state'),('effect_intent','dispatch_state')]:
  if t in names:
   rows=con.execute(f'select {col},count(*) from {t} group by {col} order by {col}').fetchall(); print(t.upper(),rows)
   inflight=sum(n for state,n in rows if state=='DISPATCHING')
   if inflight: raise SystemExit(f'ABORT_INFLIGHT_{t}:{inflight}')
 con.close()
f.close()
PY
RC=$?
if [ "$RC" = 42 ]; then exit 0; fi
python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime,json,os,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime'); h='a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b'; dest=root/'releases'/f'{h}-full-777-v1'; cur=root/'current'; prev=str(cur.resolve()) if cur.exists() else None; t=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
receipts=root/'activation_receipts'; receipts.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); (receipts/'777-a676-pre.json').write_text(json.dumps({'previous_release':prev,'target_release':str(dest),'target_head':h,'at':t},indent=2)+'\n')
tmp=root/'.current-777-a676';
try: tmp.unlink()
except FileNotFoundError: pass
os.symlink(dest,tmp); os.replace(tmp,cur)
meta={'omega_head':h,'release_dir':str(dest),'activated_at':t,'source':'777_convergence','previous_release':prev,'transport_boundary':'OUTER_SPOOL','relay_mode':'BOUNDED_NONBLOCKING'}
m=root/'CURRENT_RELEASE.json.tmp-777-a676'; m.write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n'); os.replace(m,root/'CURRENT_RELEASE.json')
print('CURRENT_AFTER',cur.resolve()); print('PREVIOUS',prev)
PY
mkdir -p "$ROOT/state/logs"
nohup env PYTHONPATH="$DEST" OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT="$ROOT/state" OMEGA_REPO_ROOT="$DEST" OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB="$ROOT/data/omega_unified.db" OMEGA_ROUTER_CONFIG="$DEST/config/organ_router.json" OMEGA_AUTONOMY_POLICY="$DEST/config/autonomy_policy.json" OMEGA_CARRIER_REPO="$ROOT/carrier_repo" OMEGA_OUTER_SPOOL="$ROOT/state/outer_bridge" python3 -m omega.supervisor_outer --runtime-root "$ROOT/state" --repo-root "$DEST" >>"$ROOT/state/logs/supervisor-outer-launch.log" 2>&1 </dev/null &
echo LAUNCH_PID=$!
sleep 8
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,pathlib,sqlite3,time
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime'); status=root/'state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json'; meta=json.loads((root/'CURRENT_RELEASE.json').read_text()); assert meta['omega_head']=='a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b'
d=json.loads(status.read_text()); pid=int(d['pid']); os.kill(pid,0); print('SUPERVISOR_PID',pid); print('TRANSPORT',d.get('transport_boundary')); print('RELAY_MODE',d.get('relay_mode')); print('REPO_ROOT',d.get('repo_root')); children=d.get('children') or {}; print('CHILDREN',json.dumps({k:v.get('alive') for k,v in children.items()},sort_keys=True)); assert children and all(v.get('alive') for v in children.values()); assert d.get('transport_boundary')=='OUTER_SPOOL'; assert d.get('relay_mode')=='BOUNDED_NONBLOCKING'
rs=root/'state/RELAY_STATUS.json'; print('RELAY_STATUS_EXISTS',rs.exists());
if rs.exists():
 r=json.loads(rs.read_text()); print('RELAY_STATUS',json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('mode','queued_eligible','inflight','long_running')},separators=(',',':')))
g=root/'state/STATUS.json'; print('GRID_STATUS_EXISTS',g.exists());
if g.exists():
 x=json.loads(g.read_text()); print('GRID_STATUS',json.dumps({k:x.get(k) for k in ('updated_at','runtime_epoch_id','frame_id','state')},separators=(',',':')))
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{root / "data/omega_unified.db"}?mode=ro',uri=True); tables={r[0] for r in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")}; counts={};
for t in ('frame','task','effect_intent','relay_ledger','observation','bridge_message'):
 if t in tables: counts[t]=con.execute(f'select count(*) from {t}').fetchone()[0]
con.close(); print('DB_COUNTS',json.dumps(counts,sort_keys=True)); print('OMEGA_CENTRAL_LIVE=PASS')
PY
